messages:
Nate: Quick sync : thinking about finalizing approach for stitching late-arriving billing/tenant attrs. Two options floated: full durable ledger vs lightweight miss-capture + ephemeral map. Thoughts?
Iris: Ledger gives auditability & deterministic replays. Tradeoffs: storage, shards, compaction.
Omar: Ephemeral map cheaper but brittle for backfills; we can't easily prove historical state for audits.
Lea: Must avoid sync write on ingest. If we do a ledger it must be async append-only with a local fast ACK path.
Nate: What about a hybrid: default path skips ledger if attrs present; only emit a miss-event for traces missing attrs. That keeps volume small and gives durable trail for late attribution.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: sample ingest snapshot (2026-03-22T02:15Z): regional p95 ~13.5k tps, p99 ~16.0k tps.
Iris: Back-of-envelope: if miss-rate ~3-6% ledger QPS is manageable. Store entries tiny and compress. Add compaction to dedupe repeated misses.
Omar: UX: analytics needs a provisional/final flag plus finalized_at timestamp so dashboards can show drift. Also expose reconciliation lag metric.
Lea: Ops: alerts for ledger write backlog, compaction lag >30m, reconciliation error rate >1%. Default retention 7d, extendable for audits.
Nate: Action items: Omar -> analytics schema + migration plan. Iris -> small append PoC and cost sim. Lea -> SLOs/alerting doc. I'll draft RFC addendum with recommended hybrid and owners. Meeting Fri 11 to review PoC. :thumbsup:
